intestazione: Cluster 3 — Open agricultural and human periphery | Exceptions and internal tensions

eccezioni.titolo: Strong visual emergence of the volcano
eccezioni.testo: The volcanic profile is clearly perceivable but remains in the background and does not dominate the agricultural matrix.
A concentrated presence of sheds and production plants that stands out from the context but does not replace the agricultural matrix.
A small woodland patch introducing a local variation without altering the dominant agricultural openness.
A punctual historical-cultural element that emerges locally but is not widespread in the cluster.
